blocks.text: O'zbek tilida eshitilgan, aniq tasdiqlanmagan ma'lumot uchun maxsus grammatik vosita bor: **-mish / emish / ekan** (U boy **emish**, Ko'chib ketgan **ekan**) va «**aytishlaricha**», «**deyishadi**», «**... deb hisoblanadi**» kabi iboralar. Ingliz tilida bunday qo'shimcha yo'q — o'rniga majhul nisbatdagi say, believe, think, know, report, expect, consider fe'llari ishlatiladi: **It is said that** ... / He **is said to** ... Bu qoliplar ayniqsa yangiliklar va rasmiy matnlarda ko'p uchraydi, chunki ma'lumot manbasi aniq ko'rsatilmaydi. Majhul nisbat asoslari — 42–43-darslarda.

items.text: **It is said that** the owner of the hotel is a famous footballer.
**It is expected that** the bridge will reopen in May.
**It is known that** stress can cause serious illness.

blocks.text: Ikkinchi qolip: He is said to ...

Xuddi shu ma'noni boshqacha ham aytish mumkin: gap haqida bo'layotgan odam yoki narsa **ega** bo'ladi, fe'l esa **to + infinitiv** shaklida keladi: It is said that he **is** very rich → He **is said to be** very rich. Bu qolip qisqaroq va yangiliklarda juda ommabop. **Diqqat**: ikki qolipni aralashtirib bo'lmaydi — «He is said that he is rich» xato.

rows: It is said that he **lives** in London.
He **is said to live** in London.
It is believed that she **is working** on a new book.
She **is believed to be working** on a new book.
It is thought that the thief **escaped** by car.
The thief **is thought to have escaped** by car.
It is reported that two people **were injured**.
Two people **are reported to have been injured**.
It is expected that prices **will rise**.

blocks.text: to do, to be doing yoki to have done?

Infinitiv shakli harakat **qachon** bo'lganiga qarab tanlanadi. Hozirgi holat yoki odat — **to be / to do** (He is said **to be** ill). Ayni paytda davom etayotgan harakat — **to be doing** (She is said **to be writing** a book). O'tmishda bo'lib o'tgan harakat — **to have done** (He is said **to have left** the country). Kelajak — expect bilan oddiy **to do** (The talks are expected **to end** tomorrow). O'zbekchada farq fe'l zamonida ko'rinadi: ketgan **emish** — **to have left**, ketyapti **emish** — **to be leaving**.

items.text: The robbers **are thought to have left** the city by car.
items.translation: Talonchilar shahardan mashinada **chiqib ketgan deb taxmin qilinmoqda**.

items.text: Kate's grandmother **is said to speak** six languages fluently.
The president **is reported to be staying** at a hotel in Samarkand.

blocks.text: O'tmishdagi fikr uchun **be** o'tgan zamonga o'tadi: **It was believed that** the Earth was flat. = The Earth **was believed to be** flat. — Yer yassi **deb hisoblangan**.

So'zlashuvda «is said to» o'rniga ko'pincha **be supposed to** ishlatiladi. Ma'nosi bir xil — boshqalardan eshitilgan fikr: The new museum **is supposed to be** fantastic — Yangi muzey ajoyib **emish**. Bu yerda «supposed» — sifat kabi ishlaydi, shuning uchun doim **-d** bilan yoziladi: «is suppose to» xato.
be supposed to — 2) reja, majburiyat, qoida

be supposed to ning ikkinchi, juda ko'p ishlatiladigan ma'nosi — **nima bo'lishi kerakligi**: kelishuv, reja, vazifa yoki qoida. O'tmishda (**was supposed to**) u ko'pincha reja **amalga oshmaganini** bildiradi: The train **was supposed to** arrive at 8 — Poyezd 8 da **kelishi kerak edi** (lekin kelmadi). Inkor shakli **not supposed to** — «qoidaga ko'ra mumkin emas»: You**'re not supposed to** park here.

rows: This café **is supposed to be** the best in town.
I**'m supposed to** call my boss at five.
The parcel **was supposed to** arrive yesterday.
You**'re not supposed to** smoke here.

items.text: The new science museum **is supposed to be** fantastic.
We**'re supposed to** hand in our essays by Friday.
Visitors **aren't supposed to** touch the paintings.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He is said that he is rich» → **It is said that** he is rich / He **is said to be** rich (ikki qolip aralashmaydi); «It is said him to be rich» → He **is said to be** rich; o'tgan harakat uchun «He is said to steal the money» → He is said **to have stolen** the money; «I'm suppose to go» → I'm **supposed** to go (-d tushib qolmasin); «I am supposing to call him» → I**'m supposed to** call him (Continuous emas).

O'zbekcha gapda **-mish / emish** yoki «**aytishlaricha**» ko'rsangiz — inglizchada **is said to** / **is supposed to** qo'llang. «**... kerak edi**» (reja bajarilmagan) ko'rsangiz — **was supposed to**. O'tgan voqea haqidagi mish-mishda to dan keyin **have + V3** ni unutmang.

rows: It is said / believed / thought that ...
**It is believed that** the city is 2,500 years old.
He **is said to be** a genius.
She **is said to be planning** a trip.
They **are said to have met** in Paris.
The film **is supposed to be** good.
I **was supposed to** call her. You**'re not supposed to** smoke.

examples.title: **It is said / believed that** ...
examples.description: Mavhum it + majhul fe'l + that: umumiy fikr, mish-mish, rasmiy xabar. O'zbekchada «aytishlaricha», «deb hisoblanadi», «kutilmoqda».

sentences.text: **It is said that** the old caravanserai near Bukhara is haunted.
sentences.translation: **Aytishlaricha**, Buxoro yaqinidagi eski karvonsaroyda arvoh bor ekan.

sentences.text: **It is believed that** Samarkand is more than 2,700 years old.
sentences.translation: Samarqand 2700 yildan ortiq yoshda **deb hisoblanadi**.

sentences.text: Nowadays **it is widely accepted that** regular exercise improves mental health.
sentences.translation: Hozirgi kunda muntazam jismoniy mashq ruhiy salomatlikni yaxshilashi **keng e'tirof etilgan**.

sentences.text: In our family **it is considered** rude to start eating before the oldest person does.
sentences.translation: Oilamizda eng katta odamdan oldin ovqatlanishni boshlash odobsizlik **hisoblanadi**.

sentences.text: **It's thought that** the fire started in the kitchen of the restaurant.
sentences.translation: Yong'in restoran oshxonasida boshlangan **deb taxmin qilinmoqda**.

sentences.text: According to the forecast, **it is expected that** temperatures will reach forty degrees this week.
sentences.translation: Prognozga ko'ra, bu hafta harorat qirq darajaga yetishi **kutilmoqda**.

sentences.text: Although **it is often said that** money can't buy happiness, most people would like more of it.
sentences.translation: Pul bilan baxt sotib olib bo'lmaydi, **deb ko'p aytishadi**, lekin ko'pchilik undan ko'proq bo'lishini xohlaydi.

sentences.text: **Is it known** how many people were on the boat when it sank?
sentences.translation: Qayiq cho'kkanida unda qancha odam bo'lgani **ma'lummi**?

sentences.text: These days **it is generally agreed that** children spend too much time on screens.
sentences.translation: Bugungi kunda bolalar ekran oldida juda ko'p vaqt o'tkazishiga **deyarli hamma qo'shiladi**.

sentences.text: In today's papers **it is reported that** the factory will close and four hundred jobs will be lost.
sentences.translation: Bugungi gazetalarda zavod yopilishi va to'rt yuz kishi ishsiz qolishi **xabar qilinmoqda**.

examples.title: **He is said to be** / **is thought to earn**
examples.description: Ega + is said / believed / thought + to + infinitiv: hozirgi holat yoki odat haqida eshitilgan fikr. O'zbekchada ko'pincha «-mish / emish».

sentences.text: Mr Karimov **is said to be** the richest man in the whole region.
sentences.translation: **Aytishlaricha**, janob Karimov butun viloyatdagi eng boy odam.

sentences.text: The new manager **is believed to be** very strict about punctuality.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer vaqtga rioya qilish masalasida juda qattiqqo'l **emish**.

sentences.text: This herbal tea **is said to help** with headaches and poor sleep.
sentences.translation: Bu o'simlik choyi bosh og'rig'i va uyqusizlikka **yordam berarmish**.

sentences.text: Tashkent **is considered to be** one of the safest capitals in Central Asia.
sentences.translation: Toshkent Markaziy Osiyodagi eng xavfsiz poytaxtlardan biri **hisoblanadi**.

sentences.text: Our most famous singer **is thought to earn** more than a million dollars a year.
sentences.translation: Eng mashhur xonandamiz yiliga million dollardan ortiq **ishlab topadi, deb taxmin qilinadi**.

sentences.text: Dolphins **are known to be** extremely intelligent and social animals.
sentences.translation: Delfinlar o'ta aqlli va ijtimoiy hayvonlar ekani **ma'lum**.

sentences.text: Who **is expected to win** the election? — Most people think it will be close.
sentences.translation: Saylovda kim **g'alaba qozonishi kutilyapti**? — Ko'pchilik natija juda yaqin bo'ladi deb o'ylaydi.

sentences.text: Bekzod's grandfather **is said to know** every street in the old city by heart.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning bobosi eski shahardagi har bir ko'chani yoddan **bilarmish**.

sentences.text: The missing climbers **are believed to be** somewhere on the north side of the mountain.
sentences.translation: Bedarak yo'qolgan alpinistlar tog'ning shimoliy yonbag'rida **bo'lsa kerak, deb taxmin qilinmoqda**.

sentences.text: Kate's favourite actor **is said to be writing** a book about his childhood.
sentences.translation: Keytning sevimli aktyori bolaligi haqida kitob **yozayotgan emish**.

examples.title: **is believed to have done**: earlier events
examples.description: Harakat o'tmishda bo'lgan bo'lsa — to have + V3; majhul harakat bo'lsa — to have been + V3. O'zbekchada: qochib ketgan **emish**, qurgani **ma'lum**.

sentences.text: The thieves **are thought to have escaped** through a window at the back.
sentences.translation: O'g'rilar orqa tomondagi deraza orqali **qochib ketgan deb taxmin qilinmoqda**.

sentences.text: Alexander the Great **is said to have married** a local princess near Samarkand.
sentences.translation: **Aytishlaricha**, Iskandar Zulqarnayn Samarqand yaqinida mahalliy malikaga **uylangan**.

sentences.text: Several people **are reported to have been injured** in the explosion.
sentences.translation: Portlashda bir necha kishi **jarohatlangani xabar qilinmoqda**.

sentences.text: The company **is believed to have lost** millions of dollars last year.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya o'tgan yili millionlab dollar **yo'qotgan deb hisoblanadi**.

sentences.text: Ulugh Beg **is known to have built** an observatory in Samarkand in the 1420s.
sentences.translation: Ulug'bek 1420-yillarda Samarqandda rasadxona **qurgani ma'lum**.

sentences.text: Madina's neighbour **is said to have won** the lottery, but he still drives an old car.
sentences.translation: Madinaning qo'shnisi lotereya **yutgan emish**, lekin hali ham eski mashina haydaydi.

sentences.text: Who **is thought to have written** this anonymous letter to the director?
sentences.translation: Direktorga yozilgan bu imzosiz xatni kim **yozgan deb o'ylashyapti**?

sentences.text: The fire **is believed to have been caused** by a cigarette.
sentences.translation: Yong'inga sigaret **sabab bo'lgan deb taxmin qilinmoqda**.

sentences.text: James **is said to live** in London now, and he **is said to have sold** his house in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Jeyms hozir Londonda **yasharmish**, Oksforddagi uyini esa **sotib yuborgan emish**.

sentences.text: Hundreds of ancient coins **are thought to have been buried** here during a war.
sentences.translation: Bu yerga urush paytida yuzlab qadimiy tangalar **ko'mib qo'yilgan deb taxmin qilinadi**.

examples.title: News style: **is expected to**, **is reported to**
examples.description: Yangiliklar uslubi: expect, report, estimate, allege, understand, forecast. Kelajak — to + fe'l, davom etayotgan — to be + -ing.

sentences.text: The minister **is expected to announce** new tax rules later today.
sentences.translation: Vazir bugun kechroq yangi soliq qoidalarini **e'lon qilishi kutilmoqda**.

sentences.text: Prices **are expected to rise** again after the summer holidays.
sentences.translation: Yozgi ta'tildan keyin narxlar yana **oshishi kutilmoqda**.

sentences.text: Over two thousand people **are estimated to have attended** the concert.
sentences.translation: Konsertga ikki mingdan ortiq odam **kelgan deb hisoblanmoqda**.

sentences.text: The two companies **are reported to be discussing** a possible merger.
sentences.translation: Ikki kompaniya birlashish **haqida muzokara olib borayotgani xabar qilinmoqda**.

sentences.text: Manchester United's captain **is understood to be** unhappy at the club.
sentences.translation: «Manchester Yunayted» sardori klubdan **norozi ekan**.

sentences.text: A man **is alleged to have stolen** paintings worth two million pounds.
sentences.translation: Bir erkak ikki million funtlik rasmlarni **o'g'irlaganlikda ayblanmoqda**.

sentences.text: Heavy snow **is expected to cause** delays on the mountain roads this weekend.
sentences.translation: Bu dam olish kunlari kuchli qor tog' yo'llarida **tirbandlikka sabab bo'lishi kutilmoqda**.

sentences.text: **It is understood that** the president will visit Khiva next month.
sentences.translation: **Ma'lum bo'lishicha**, prezident kelasi oy Xivaga tashrif buyuradi.

sentences.text: Unemployment **is forecast to fall** slightly next year, according to the central bank.
sentences.translation: Markaziy bank ma'lumotiga ko'ra, kelasi yil ishsizlik biroz **kamayishi bashorat qilinmoqda**.

sentences.text: Two suspects are being questioned, and a third **is believed to have left** the country.
sentences.translation: Ikki gumonlanuvchi so'roq qilinyapti, uchinchisi esa mamlakatdan **chiqib ketgan deb taxmin qilinmoqda**.

examples.title: The past view: **it was believed**, **was thought to be**
examples.description: O'tmishdagi fikr: be o'tgan zamonda — it was believed that ..., he was thought to be ... O'zbekchada «deb hisoblangan», «deb o'ylashardi».

sentences.text: For centuries **it was believed that** the Earth was the centre of the universe.
sentences.translation: Asrlar davomida Yer koinotning markazi **deb hisoblangan**.

sentences.text: The ship **was thought to be** unsinkable, but it sank on its first voyage.
sentences.translation: Kema cho'kmaydigan **deb hisoblangan edi**, lekin u birinchi safaridayoq cho'kib ketdi.

sentences.text: In the past, smoking **was considered** stylish, and even doctors appeared in cigarette adverts.
sentences.translation: Ilgari chekish **zamonaviy hisoblanardi**, hatto shifokorlar sigaret reklamalarida chiqishardi.

sentences.text: At first the illness **was believed to be** a simple flu.
sentences.translation: Avvaliga kasallik oddiy gripp **deb o'ylangan edi**.

sentences.text: Silk **was said to be** worth more than gold along the Great Silk Road.
sentences.translation: **Aytishlaricha**, Buyuk Ipak yo'lida ipak oltindan ham qimmat **bo'lgan**.

sentences.text: When I was a child, **it was thought that** carrots helped you see in the dark.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda sabzi qorong'ida yaxshi ko'rishga yordam beradi, **deb o'ylashardi**.

sentences.text: Our team **was expected to lose**, but we won three-nil.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz **yutqazadi, deb kutilgan edi**, lekin biz uch-nol hisobida yutdik.

sentences.text: Until last year, the old manuscript **was believed to have been lost** forever.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yilgacha qadimiy qo'lyozma butunlay **yo'qolgan deb hisoblanardi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar's grandfather **was known to be** the best carpet maker in Khiva.
sentences.translation: Nilufarning bobosi Xivadagi eng yaxshi gilamdo'z **sifatida tanilgan edi**.

sentences.text: Why **was it assumed that** the young engineer couldn't lead the project?
sentences.translation: Nega yosh muhandis loyihani boshqara olmaydi, **deb o'ylashdi**?

examples.title: **is supposed to be** = people say
examples.description: be supposed to — so'zlashuvda «deyishadi», «emish» ma'nosida: o'zimiz ko'rmagan, boshqalardan eshitgan baho yoki ma'lumot.

sentences.text: The new Korean restaurant on Navoi Street **is supposed to be** excellent.
sentences.translation: Navoiy ko'chasidagi yangi koreys restorani a'lo **emish**.

sentences.text: This film **is supposed to be** really scary — are you sure you want to watch it?
sentences.translation: Bu film juda qo'rqinchli **deyishadi** — rostdan ko'rmoqchimisan?

sentences.text: Drinking green tea **is supposed to be** good for your heart.
sentences.translation: Ko'k choy ichish yurak uchun **foydali emish**.

sentences.text: Isn't Edinburgh **supposed to be** one of the most beautiful cities in Europe?
sentences.translation: Edinburg Yevropaning eng go'zal shaharlaridan biri **deyishadi-ku**?

sentences.text: Their new album **is supposed to be** much better than the last one.
sentences.translation: Eshitishimcha, ularning yangi albomi oldingisidan ancha **yaxshi ekan**.

sentences.text: Aziz **is supposed to be** a brilliant chess player, but I've never seen him play.
sentences.translation: Aziz zo'r shaxmatchi **emish**, lekin men uning o'ynaganini hech ko'rmaganman.

sentences.text: These new tablets **are supposed to work** within twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Bu yangi tabletkalar yigirma daqiqada **ta'sir qilarmish**.

sentences.text: Kate's new boyfriend **is supposed to have lived** in Japan for five years.
sentences.translation: Keytning yangi yigiti Yaponiyada besh yil **yashagan emish**.

sentences.text: Is that new café any good? — It**'s supposed to be** the best in town.
sentences.translation: O'sha yangi kafe yaxshimi? — Shahardagi **eng zo'ri deyishadi**.

sentences.text: The view from the top of the tower **is supposed to be** amazing at sunset.
sentences.translation: Quyosh botayotganda minora tepasidan manzara **ajoyib bo'larkan**.

examples.title: **was supposed to** / **'m not supposed to**: plans and rules
examples.description: be supposed to — reja, vazifa, qoida. was supposed to — reja amalga oshmadi («... kerak edi»), not supposed to — qoidaga ko'ra mumkin emas.

sentences.text: I**'m supposed to** meet Jasur at six, but I'm stuck in traffic.
sentences.translation: Jasur bilan soat oltida **uchrashishim kerak**, lekin tirbandlikda qolib ketdim.

sentences.text: The train **was supposed to** arrive at 8.15, but it was forty minutes late.
sentences.translation: Poyezd 8:15 da **kelishi kerak edi**, lekin qirq daqiqa kechikdi.

sentences.text: You**'re not supposed to** use your phone while you're driving.
sentences.translation: Mashina haydayotganda telefondan **foydalanish mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: What **are** we **supposed to** do if the fire alarm goes off at night?
sentences.translation: Kechasi yong'in signalizatsiyasi chalinsa, nima **qilishimiz kerak**?

sentences.text: Sarah **was supposed to** send me the report yesterday, but she forgot.
sentences.translation: Sara menga hisobotni kecha **yuborishi kerak edi**, lekin unutib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Students **aren't supposed to** eat in the library, but many of them do.
sentences.translation: Talabalar kutubxonada **ovqatlanmasligi kerak**, lekin ko'plari ovqatlanadi.

sentences.text: This dress **was supposed to** be a surprise — who told you about it?
sentences.translation: Bu ko'ylak **syurpriz bo'lishi kerak edi** — buni senga kim aytdi?

sentences.text: Aren't you **supposed to** be at work today? — Yes, but I've got a terrible cold.
sentences.translation: Bugun ishda **bo'lishing kerak emasmidi**? — Ha, lekin qattiq shamollab qoldim.

sentences.text: Our flight **was supposed to** leave at noon, so why are we still sitting here?
sentences.translation: Reysimiz tushda **uchishi kerak edi**, unda nega hali ham shu yerda o'tiribmiz?

sentences.text: Nobody **was supposed to** know about the plan, but somehow the news got out.
sentences.translation: Bu reja haqida hech kim **bilmasligi kerak edi**, lekin qandaydir yo'l bilan xabar tarqalib ketdi.

examples.title: Mixed: news, gossip and broken plans
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: It is said that ..., is believed to (have) ..., is supposed to — ikki ma'nosida.

sentences.text: Police say the stolen painting **is believed to have been taken** abroad.
sentences.translation: Politsiya ma'lumotiga ko'ra, o'g'irlangan rasm chet elga **olib chiqib ketilgan deb taxmin qilinmoqda**.

sentences.text: **It is said that** a cup of green tea after plov helps digestion.
sentences.translation: **Aytishlaricha**, palovdan keyin bir piyola ko'k choy hazmga yordam beradi.

sentences.text: The bus **was supposed to** come ten minutes ago — let's just take a taxi.
sentences.translation: Avtobus o'n daqiqa oldin **kelishi kerak edi** — yaxshisi taksiga o'tiraylik.

sentences.text: The new metro line **is expected to be** finished by the end of next year.
sentences.translation: Yangi metro liniyasi kelasi yil oxirigacha **qurib bitkazilishi kutilmoqda**.

sentences.text: Our new neighbours **are said to be** very friendly, but we haven't met them yet.
sentences.translation: Yangi qo'shnilarimiz juda **samimiy emish**, lekin hali ular bilan tanishmadik.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **is thought to have** the best chance of winning the scholarship.
sentences.translation: Stipendiyani yutishga eng katta imkoniyat Dilnozada, **deb hisoblashadi**.

sentences.text: You **weren't supposed to** tell anyone about the party! It was a secret.
sentences.translation: Ziyofat haqida hech kimga **aytmasliging kerak edi**! Bu sir edi-ku.

sentences.text: In ancient times **it was believed that** comets brought bad luck.
sentences.translation: Qadim zamonlarda kometalar omadsizlik keltiradi, **deb ishonishgan**.

sentences.text: Hundreds of birds **are reported to have died** after the oil spill near the coast.
sentences.translation: Qirg'oq yaqinida neft to'kilgandan keyin yuzlab qushlar **nobud bo'lgani xabar qilinmoqda**.

sentences.text: Tom **is said to be leaving** the company, though he hasn't told us anything yet.
sentences.translation: Tom kompaniyadan **ketayotgan emish**, garchi bizga hali hech narsa demagan bo'lsa ham.
